definition: A normalization technique that normalizes activations across the features of a single training example rather than across a batch.
details: Layer normalization is widely used in transformer architectures because it works well with variable sequence lengths and small batch sizes, unlike batch normalization.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Boil it down and it is this: A normalization technique that normalizes activations across the features of a single training example rather than across a batch. Here is why it matters: Layer normalization is widely used in transformer architectures because it works well with variable sequence lengths and small batch sizes, unlike batch normalization. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Layer Normalization.
